what: 3. Problems that run through the whole book
title: Basketball Data Science (Zuccolotto & Manisera, CRC 2020): a close reading
text: Uncertainty never shown. interval band appears percentage, Gini, cluster mean, kernel curve correlation difference. text often says “rather weak evidence”. fix simple: bootstrap bands, beta-binomial intervals , project, Bayesian posteriors. Small samples taken face value. Shrinkage (empirical Bayes hierarchical) standard remedy fits project’s brms/Stan goal. Everything relative analysed subset. Four-factor differences 4 teams, radial plots standardised 9 point guards, η² 30 teams. Comparisons relative league (position), subset highlighted inside . Per-minute, per-possession. Player rates per minute, pace differences leak . matters NBA vs EuroLeague comparisons (40 vs 48 minutes, different pace). One team, one season, one league. book raises “space generalizability” (NBA ≠ Europe, p. 6) never tests . NBA vs EuroLeague project exactly . rainbow red–green palettes; dual axes; legends direct labels work; case numbers labels; 9-panel radial grids; default ggplot grey; court sectors ignore court lines. lead story (title finding, subtitle encoding); put subject context (grey league, coloured subject); label directly; use one diverging scale red = better average; encode volume size line width eye goes data . Causal language observational splits. /assist networks, top vs bottom opponents, playoff vs non-playoff correlations. fine descriptions framed (adjusted lineup opponent model).

text: report holds: * key findings words; * game flow; * win probability, plays swung ; * decided result, mattered; * every shot; * box scores, clutch time line-ups. one self-contained HTML file figures inside, ready e-mail post. Examples: Olympiacos 84-78 Olimpia Milano Oklahoma City 103-91 Indiana, 2025 NBA Finals Game 7. 1. Find game. 2. Make report. takes 10 seconds. file saved working directory <home>-<away>-<date>.html opens browser. 3. Optional extras. 4. Share . Send HTML file attachment, put shared drive, publish website. needs R internet connection open. quick message, match_story() gives key findings text: 5. Report several games .
